authenticity_review: The image has strong perceptual quality with sharp focus and natural lighting, but exhibits clear AI artifacts. Paws lack toe definition and appear as smooth fused stumps blending into grass (texture anomaly, severity 2). Inner ear structures are oversimplified and plastic-like, especially on rightmost rabbits (structural collapse, severity 2). Missing occlusion shadows at paw-grass interface creates slight pasted-on effect (perspective distortion, severity 1). These compound defects justify a moderate authenticity penalty despite overall clean appearance.
